order_note: No predecessor. SQL 162 adds one SECURITY DEFINER read function and replaces nothing (owner 2026-11-12: "If you pay from a shared check using Send from the Funds tab ... It should not send the partner check back to deposited", "Sends to someone other than the partner", "Yes for 1, 2, and run the inspect"): get_shared_check_source_sends(uuid) returns, for the caller's organization (aws_can_access_tenant, 42501 otherwise), one row per check and sharing organization for the checks actively shared with it (shared_checks, revoked_at IS NULL) from which the sharing organization has a payment_transfers send leg (send_wallet / send_bank; submitted, pending, processing, completed) whose destination is not the caller's organization; columns check_id, source_tenant_id and last_sent_at only, never an amount, a payee or a status; EXECUTE checksops and the owner only. The spec prerequisites are the file's own (55000 sql162_prerequisite_missing); the applying login must reach payment_transfers and shared_checks as the definer past RLS (definer_can_write_relations; the file refuses otherwise, sql162_definer_cannot_reach). No table, column, policy, table grant, trigger or row changes, so the db-readonly-validate trigger count is not affected. Expected pre-state in both environments: the function absent (release sql162 v1: eb3a290173a156be3757f03c0217b4548bffe713f582cdc6f32b676e91317e4f, releaseStateHash('sql162', {})). The API (get_shared_check_source_sends in the read RPC list with the tenant gate) and the Check Command Center ship after this through their own guarded paths; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
